description: Open-web discovery used 43 captured search invocations with Portuguese, English, and attempted Kriolu variants; week/date windows; national outlets (including RTC, A Nação, Inforpress, Tiver, Mindel Insite, Expresso das Ilhas and A Semana); and sector/island/place terms spanning labor, teachers, students, residents, justice, utilities, prices, transport, health, and islands/cities. Search coverage is uneven; the Kriolu queries returned no clearly relevant January event lead, and no systematic Kriolu news corpus, local hemeroteca, LexisNexis-equivalent access, or complete archive search was available. All 14 current source cards are search-only and no article body was read in this first pass.
required_followup: Coordinator or later reviewer may pursue local-language archives, additional regional outlets, or exact source-body checks where they could resolve an eligibility/threshold question. Do not interpret missing search results as absence of protest.
